# Epoxy Custom Coatings

> Epoxy flooring contractor on Vancouver Island, British Columbia, Canada.
> Certified PMMA flooring installers on Vancouver Island, trained through Plasti-Chemie Germany.
> Tagline: Keep your feet on better ground.

## Business Summary

Epoxy Custom Coatings installs epoxy flooring, polyaspartic coatings, certified PMMA flooring, flake and metallic epoxy floors, ESD flooring, and specialty concrete floor coatings for commercial, industrial, winery, and residential clients across Vancouver Island. The company is family-owned and operated by a father-and-son-in-law team with 30 years of flooring industry experience.

## Service Area

Victoria, Langford, Saanich, Nanaimo, Duncan, Cowichan Valley, and communities across Vancouver Island, British Columbia.

## Primary Services (Commercial & Industrial Focus)

- Commercial and industrial epoxy flooring (restaurants, commercial kitchens, wineries, tasting rooms, retail, parkades, warehouses, manufacturing, food processing, auto shops, healthcare)
- Certified PMMA flooring (ultra-fast cure, extreme cold installation, minimal downtime)
- ESD flooring and static-control coatings (labs, data centers, medical facilities, electronics manufacturing)
- Residential garage floor epoxy and polyaspartic coatings (garages, basements, workshops, patios; residential also available)
- Flake epoxy systems and metallic epoxy floors

## Coating Systems

Epoxy floor coatings, polyaspartic flooring, certified PMMA, polyurethane topcoats, metallic epoxy, flake epoxy systems, microcement, decorative lime, ESD flooring
